welcome.blurb: Mobile-first social deduction. Stealth night, automated narrator or assisted Master — with no signals that betray who is awake.

rules.title: Rules
rules.blurb: Nocturna in plain language — for Host and players.

goal.title: Goal
goal.body:
Two main sides play (plus optional Lone / Neutral roles).

• Village wins when no Shadows remain alive.
• Shadows win when their living members equal or outnumber living Villagers.
• A Lone or Neutral with a “last survivor” goal wins only if they are the last one alive.

Keep your role card hidden. You may lie out loud; never show your private phone screen.

phases.title: Phases
phases.body:
Each cycle has four phases:

1. Night — eyes closed. Phones wake protectors first, then investigators, then the Shadow hunt, then other roles. Nobody should learn who is awake.
2. Dawn — any fallen players are announced.
3. Discussion — talk, accuse, defend.
4. Tribunal — vote who to eliminate. Ties follow the Host’s setting (no elimination, or a runoff).

Then Night starts again until a side wins. A good rule of thumb is about one Shadow hunter per five seats — tense without giving Shadows an auto-win at deal.

night.title: Night stealth
night.body:
At night the screen stays dark. Do not use light, sound, or vibration to guess who is awake.

If the Host turns on the universal heartbeat, every phone buzzes the same way. Ambient audio (automated mode only) is the same loop for everyone.

Confirming your action early does not end the wake early — the timer hides who finished first.

day.title: Day & tribunal
day.body:
At dawn, names of anyone who fell at night (if any) are announced.

In Discussion you may speak freely. In Tribunal you vote to eliminate a suspect. Before the game, the Host chooses what happens on a tie and whether votes are secret or public.

modes.title: Game modes
modes.body:
• Automated narrator — the server calls each night wake on a timer. Everyone at the table is a player.
• Assisted Master — one person runs the night with a God-View board: pause, force the next step, cancel actions. The Master is not dealt a role and does not count toward winning.

stealth.title: Table manners
stealth.body: When you “sleep”, keep your phone face-down. Do not peek at neighbours. Eliminated players do not reveal their role. The Host’s QR and join link always use a reachable LAN address — never localhost on player phones.

lobby.title: Lobby · PIN
lobby.scanQr: Scan to join from any phone.
lobby.hapticsHelp: Default: phones stay silent. “Universal heartbeat” buzzes every phone the same way when a night turn changes — so nobody can tell who woke from vibration alone.
lobby.ambientAudioHelp: Soft background loop on every device during automated nights only — same sound for everyone, no role-specific cues.
lobby.voteVisibilityHelp: Secret: votes stay hidden until the tally. Public: the table can see ballots as they come in.
lobby.tieBreakHelp: No elimination: a tie means nobody is burned. Runoff: only the tied players are voted on again.
lobby.nightTurnHelp: Default length of each night wake when the role has no longer wake window. Everyone waits the full window so finishing early does not leak who acted.
lobby.assistedMultHelp: In Master-assisted mode, soft timers can run longer (duration × this factor) so the Master has time to narrate. Automated mode ignores this.
lobby.allowLateJoinHelp: If on, players may still enter the PIN after the game started — they join as spectators without a dealt role.
lobby.modeHelp: Automated narrator: the server calls night turns on a timer. Assisted Master: a Master advances turns and sees the God-View.
lobby.waitingHost: Waiting for the Host to configure and start…
lobby.lanError: No reachable LAN address. Connect the Host to Wi‑Fi or set an advertise override — localhost is not allowed.
lobby.recommendedHelp: One-tap decks for {{count}} players at the table (excluding a non-playing Master). Presets run from 6 to 24 seats. Only roles in the match (count ≥ 1) are added — others stay available under Custom game → Add a missing role.
lobby.recommendedApplied: Recommended deck applied — only roles with copies are in the party. Add others below if you need them.
lobby.recommendedBalanceHint: Shadow hunters stay ~20–28% of seats; Keeper + investigator always present; heavy specials only on large tables.
lobby.customGameHelp: Build the deck by hand: set copies per role, check the seat total against players at the table, then deal when it matches.
lobby.customComposition: {{seats}} role copies · {{players}} players at the table
lobby.customCompositionOk: Composition matches the table — ready to deal.
lobby.customCompositionShort: Too few copies for everyone — add roles or raise counts.
lobby.customCompositionOver: More copies than players — lower some counts before dealing.
lobby.customCompositionHelp: Only non-Master seats need a role. The Host deals exactly as many role copies as there are playing seats.
lobby.customAddMissingHelp: Roles from the full Nocturna catalog that are not in this game’s deck yet.
lobby.customAddMissingEmpty: Every catalog role is already in this deck.
lobby.customRoleHelp: Name, faction, description, and wake basics — same engine fields as catalog roles. Saved with the room deck and included in Export/Import.
lobby.customRoleIdClash: That role is already in the deck — rename slightly and try again.
lobby.customRoleDescriptionPlaceholder: What this role does during the night…
lobby.customRolePriorityHelp: Lower number = woken earlier in the night (call order).

winConditionLabel.EQUAL_OR_GREATER_THAN_VILLAGERS: Shadows equal or outnumber the Village

winConditionHelp.ELIMINATE_ALL_IMPOSTORS: Wins with the Village when the last Shadow falls.
winConditionHelp.EQUAL_OR_GREATER_THAN_VILLAGERS: Wins with the Shadows when they equal or outnumber living Villagers.
winConditionHelp.LAST_SURVIVOR: Wins alone as the last living player.
winConditionHelp.CUSTOM_SURVIVE: Wins if still alive when another faction’s terminal condition fires.

roles.guideHelp: These are the roles in the current Nocturna deck — name, faction, and what they do during the night.
roles.guideEditableHint: You can edit names and descriptions before dealing. Players will see your text when they reveal their role.
roles.roleDescriptionHint: Shown on the hold-to-reveal card. Keep it clear for new players.
roles.editorHelp: Lower call-order number = woken earlier in the night. “When they wake” and “What they do” drive the engine — nothing is hard-coded per role name.
roles.raisePriorityHelp: Use the arrows to swap call order with the neighbour above or below. Lower number wakes first.
roles.lowerPriorityHelp: Use the arrows to swap call order with the neighbour above or below. Lower number wakes first.
roles.copiesHelp: How many of this role are dealt. Set to 0 to remove it from the party deck (you can add it again under Custom game).
roles.maskingHelp: Minimum time this wake stays open (milliseconds). The turn never ends early when someone taps Confirm — that stops neighbours from guessing who acted by timing.

frequencyHelp.EVERY_NIGHT: Woken on every night of the game.
frequencyHelp.FIRST_NIGHT_ONLY: Woken only on night 1, then sleeps for the rest of the game.
frequencyHelp.ON_TRIGGER: Not woken automatically. Only enters the night queue if the Master forces a call (advanced).

actionHelp.NONE: This role is never woken for an action (typical Citizen).
actionHelp.SINGLE_TARGET: The awake player picks one living target (e.g. protect or strike).
actionHelp.FACTION_VOTE: All living members of this faction vote together on one victim (e.g. the Shadow hunt).
actionHelp.INSPECT_TARGET: Pick one player; the result is private intel at dawn.
actionHelp.PASSIVE_INFO: Shows a short message only — no target to choose.

cittadino.name: Citizen
cittadino.description: Village. You do not wake at night and have no power. You win when no Shadows remain (dawn or tribunal).

guardia.name: Keeper
guardia.description: Village. Each night choose one living player to protect. If Shadows attack them that night, they survive until dawn.

baluardo.name: Bulwark
baluardo.description: Village. Only on night 1 may you shield one living player. From night 2 on, you do not wake.

oracolo.name: Oracle
oracolo.description: Village. Each night investigate one living player. At dawn you learn only Village or Shadows — not the exact role.

lunavista.name: Moonseer
lunavista.description: Village. You wake on odd nights only (1, 3, 5…). Investigate one living player and learn their exact role at dawn.

veglia.name: Vigil
veglia.description: Village. You pick no targets: at night you only receive a short message. You win with the Village.

eco.name: Echo
eco.description: Village. You wake on even nights. You receive a message that recalls who fell at the day’s tribunal.

legame.name: Bond
legame.description: Village. Always add two copies. Only on night 1 the two Bonds recognise each other. You win with the Village.

ombra.name: Shadow
ombra.description: Shadows. At night you vote with other living Shadows on one victim to eliminate by dawn. You win when Shadows equal or outnumber living Villagers.

caccianotte.name: Night-hunter
caccianotte.description: Shadows. Like Shadow: at night you vote with the pack on the same victim. Same win condition as the Shadows.

artiglio.name: Talon
artiglio.description: Shadows. On even nights you strike alone (in addition to the pack vote): choose one living player to cut down. You win with the Shadows.

simulacro.name: Simulacrum
simulacro.description: Hidden Shadow. You look like a Citizen and never wake. You win with the Shadows but do not know who your allies are.

vagabondo.name: Wanderer
vagabondo.description: Lone. You win only if you are the last player alive. You have no pack-hunt action.

crocevia.name: Crossroads
crocevia.description: Neutral / lone. You win only as the last survivor. On odd nights you hear a message and pick no targets.

invocatore.name: Invoker
invocatore.description: Neutral. You do not enter the night queue alone: you wake only if the Master calls you, then you receive a short message.

giudice_notte.name: Night Arbiter
giudice_notte.description: Village. Each night investigate one living player. At dawn you learn the exact role — the result stays on your phone only.

mannaia.name: Cleaver
mannaia.description: Village. On odd nights you may eliminate one living player for the Village. A wrong target will haunt the table’s trust.

crepuscolo.name: Twilight
crepuscolo.description: Lone with two faces. By day you look like a Citizen, but you win only as last survivor. Only on night 1 you hear a message; you have no team power after that.

soglia.name: Threshold
soglia.description: Village. You wake on even nights. Investigate one living player and learn only Village or Shadows at dawn (not the exact role).

corvo.name: Raven
corvo.description: Village. Each night you receive a message: you may mentally mark a name to accuse at dawn. You do not force tribunal votes.

fiamma_fredda.name: Cold Flame
fiamma_fredda.description: Shadows. Only on night 1 may you strike one living player alone, before the pack vote. You win with the Shadows.

reveal.title: Your identity
reveal.hint: Press and hold to reveal. Release to hide — no shoulder surfing.
reveal.waitingHost: Waiting for the Host to begin the night…

night.sleepHint: Eyes closed. No signals. Wait for the shared heartbeat.
night.submitted: Action recorded. Wait for the micro-turn to end…

hostApp.blurb: Start the LAN server. Players open the URL on their phones (or scan the lobby QR) — no Node install required.
hostApp.lanOnly: LAN URLs only (no loopback in QR)
hostApp.noLan: No LAN IP — connect Wi‑Fi or set an override.
